gameData.backstory: Found as a freshly hatched duckling amidst the radioactive slag heaps outside Choochy's Chop Shop, 'Mad' Hatter was raised on a diet of motor oil and spare parts. The radiation, combined with Choochy's...eccentric...upbringing, instilled in him a fascination for shiny objects and a disturbing lack of empathy for other ducks.
gameData.name: 'Mad' Hatter
gameData.personality: Obsessive: Mad Hatter is consumed by his projects and often forgets basic needs like eating or sleeping, leading to erratic behavior. Unhinged: Years of radiation exposure have scrambled his duck brain, resulting in unpredictable outbursts and a fondness for nonsensical riddles. Resourceful: His time scavenging in Choochy's scrapyard has made him adept at finding and repurposing materials for his inventions.

specialAbility.description: Mad Hatter can cobble together a 'Gearhead Grenade' from scrap parts. This homemade explosive has a chance to either do massive damage, buff allies with tech, or backfire and debuff allies/damage Hatter himself (50%/25%/25% chance).
specialAbility.name: Gearhead Grenade
